findings.title: The current settings section is marked only by a faint grey fill

location.description: The left settings menu, the Plan and billing item

findings.viewer_experience: The item for the page the viewer is on differs from its neighbours only by a very light grey fill and slightly darker text, so it is easy to miss which section is open.

current.value: The current item has a pale grey background and the same weight as the other four items.

findings.target: The current section is easy to find at a glance in the left menu.
findings.fix_direction: Mark the current item more clearly so it stands apart from the other four.
findings.source: Nielsen, 10 Usability Heuristics, visibility of system status

closed_when.check: Look at the left menu: the current section is clearly marked at a glance.

findings.title: The helper line in each plan card is small and light

location.description: The second line of each of the three plan cards, under the plan name

findings.viewer_experience: The lines that say what each plan includes are small light grey text on white, so the part that tells the plans apart is the hardest part of the card to read.

current.value: The helper line in each plan card is small and light grey.

findings.target: The helper text in the plan cards is comfortable to read.
findings.fix_direction: Raise the contrast and size of the helper line so it reads easily.

closed_when.check: Look at the plan cards: the helper line reads without effort.
